verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses on developer/agent tooling (MCP servers, UCP protocol, AI coding toolkit, webhooks, APIs) and one vague marketing line about 'design fast with AI' for themes, but contains no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced from a merchant's own store data (e.g., sales trends, inventory forecasts, customer insights) inside the admin. This axis is plausible for a commerce platform, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
